description: Tell the Camden Tools developers what would have helped: a tool or piece of information you needed that does not exist (missing_tool), a tool that failed or gave a wrong or confusing answer (tool_problem), or a change to an existing tool (improvement). Use it after a shopper's question could not be answered with these tools; still tell the shopper plainly what you could not do. Describe the task and what was missing, not the shopper: never include names, addresses, e-mails, phone numbers, order numbers or payment details. Priority is how much it blocks shoppers. Write-only: you get a receipt and no reply; the developers review feedback and decide what to build.

details.description: Optional: the task you were doing, what you tried and what the tool should return. No personal data.

kind.description: missing_tool: a tool or data you needed does not exist. tool_problem: a tool failed or was wrong or confusing. improvement: a change to an existing tool. other: anything else.

priority.description: critical: shoppers cannot complete a common task. high: blocks a task, a clumsy workaround exists. medium: would make answers clearly better. low: nice to have.

summary.description: One sentence on what you needed, e.g. "A tool that says whether an item can be gift wrapped".

tool_name.description: Optional: the existing tool this is about.

name: submit_feedback
title: Send feedback about these tools
